tools.description: Check the twinning binary and configured work directory for the declared-subset Postgres and spec-based REST twin server.
tools.name: twin_doctor

tools.description: List retained Postgres and spec-based REST twins managed for the declared client subset.
tools.name: twin_list

tools.description: Compare declared-subset Postgres-to-Postgres committed-state snapshots by replaying point lookups, filtered scans and aggregate counts from the supplied query file. Join cases are reported as skip. Oracle/TNS fidelity is deferred.

left_snapshot_path.description: Path to the left committed-state snapshot inside the workdir.

queries_path.description: Path to the proof query file inside the workdir.

report_path.description: Optional proof report output path inside the workdir.

right_snapshot_path.description: Path to the right committed-state snapshot inside the workdir.

tools.name: twin_pair_proof

tools.description: Read a bounded report for a stopped declared-subset Postgres or spec-based REST twin. Opt-in refused Postgres SQL text appears only here and can contain SQL literals.
tools.name: twin_report

tools.description: Create a seed contract for a schema supported by the declared Postgres subset.
tools.name: twin_seed_contract

tools.description: Start a Postgres twin for the declared client subset or a REST twin built from an OpenAPI spec; the REST twin refuses requests the spec does not define. Optional Postgres declaration_path sets catalog identity. Optional snapshot_path is written only when the twin stops. Opt-in refused SQL capture writes text only to the local trace file and twin_report; SQL text can contain literals, and bind values are never captured.

capture_refused_statements.description: Postgres only. Store refused SQL text in the local trace file and expose bounded samples in twin_report. Text may contain SQL literals; bind values are never captured.

restore_path.description: Optional snapshot path to restore for Postgres.

schema_path.description: Path to a schema within the declared Postgres subset.

seed_path.description: Optional seed file path for Postgres.

server_variables.description: OpenAPI server variables passed as repeated --server-variable options.

snapshot_path.description: Optional Postgres snapshot output path. The snapshot appears only after the twin stops.

spec_path.description: Path to an OpenAPI YAML or JSON spec inside the workdir; external references are refused.

verify_path.description: Optional verify artifact path for Postgres.

tools.name: twin_start

tools.description: Stop a managed declared-subset Postgres or REST twin and return its run summary.
tools.name: twin_stop
